extraction: Agent Team Work Zone roles, lifecycle, and work rules. Naming convention <slug>-<role> (e.g., architect-typesetter) lets idle hook derive workstation path from slug prefix. On CC >= 2.1.178, skills name every teammate in this convention; on prior versions hook read from idle event's team name. Framework-owned paths: skills, agents, role archetypes, scripts, hooks. User-owned paths: projects, workstations. Skills tell them apart at runtime by structure alone - directory ends in _team and contains roundtable/. No configuration file or flag needed; layout itself is the signal. Journal-based tracking records agent work sessions with structured metadata for explainability, meta-orchestration, training data generation. Combined with git commits, provides rich examples for fine-tuning development-focused LLMs.
